phases.objective: Expose a server-owned, single-use Staging schema-repair lifecycle while preserving fail-closed Production authority and same-cycle migration readback.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Staging Recovery schema-repair prepare, approve and execute System Tools
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The server resolves the allowlisted migration and execution ticket internally, executes only the selected Staging migration, and reports success only after same-cycle schema readback and durable ledger finalization.
steps: Derive migration checksum, statement count, role and target fingerprint from the repository-owned Staging runtime bootstrap contract.
Reject caller SQL, database names, script paths, target selection, ticket identifiers, signatures and migration hashes.
Require the exact typed Staging migration confirmation before issuing a single-use ticket held server-side.
Execute only the allowlisted migration under the fenced Recovery lock.
Verify role-aware schema postconditions and migration-ledger finalization before consuming approval and ticket authority.
assertions: Schema repair is advertised only for unambiguous Staging and only when every execution and readback dependency is ready.
The prepare, approval and execute lifecycle remains bound to the exact deployed main SHA and Recovery Manifest.
Execution ticket identifiers, hashes, signatures and server tokens are never disclosed to the caller.
Production schema-repair authority remains disabled and this change authorizes no live Production mutation.
Readback or ledger failure fails closed instead of reporting recovery.
